_metadata.description: Advanced crystal structures and their defect site information
_metadata.purpose: Enable correct defect construction in complex materials

Cr_Al.reason: Cr3+ replaces Al3+ directly (same oxidation state)
Cr_Al.concentration_effect: Low Cr = red ruby, high Cr = green

Fe_Al.notes: Fe3+ can substitute directly, Fe2+ needs compensation

chalcopyrite.relationship: Derived from zinc blende by cation ordering

site_identification.Cu_vs_Fe: In pymatgen, check z-coordinate: Cu at z≈0,0.5,1; Fe at z≈0.25,0.75
site_identification.by_element: species attribute directly gives element type

pymatgen_construction.method: Use Materials Project structure or build from spacegroup

steps: 3. Create second layer by translation + rotation

layer_identification.top_layer_S: S atoms with highest z (excluding vacuum)
layer_identification.bottom_layer_S: S atoms with lowest z (above substrate/vacuum)

layer_selective.description: Can create vacancy in specific layer
layer_selective.method: Select S atoms by z-coordinate range

pymatgen_construction.monolayer: Build P6_3/mmc unit cell, then slice

triangular.description: Three vacancies forming equilateral triangle on {111}
construction: 2. Find two nearest neighbors in {111} plane

linear.neighbors: Middle vacancy has 2 neighbors, ends have 1

stability.binding_energy: Larger clusters often more stable per vacancy
stability.migration: Clusters migrate slower than single vacancies

steps: 2. Identify O atom at tetrahedral site
4. Add O atom at octahedral void (0.5, 0.5, 0.5 in unit cell)
5. For supercell: divide coordinates by supercell size

110_dumbbell.description: Most stable self-interstitial in BCC Fe

construction: 3. Add C at opposite displacement (~0.3 Å)

NV.geometry: N and V are nearest neighbors along <111>

SiV.geometry: Dopant at the periodic-image midpoint of two adjacent unoccupied original C sites; split-vacancy geometry.

GeV.geometry: Dopant at the periodic-image midpoint of two adjacent unoccupied original C sites; split-vacancy geometry.

SnV.geometry: Dopant at the periodic-image midpoint of two adjacent unoccupied original C sites; split-vacancy geometry.

NVN_center.also_called: N2V; H3 denotes the neutral N2V0 optical center

geometry.description: Two substitutional N atoms occupy two distinct nearest-neighbor sites of one vacancy in diamond. The ideal N2V arrangement has C2v symmetry; the two vacancy-to-N directions are not opposite.

construction: 1. Retain a verified pristine diamond reference and choose the site to become vacant
2. Enumerate its periodic first-neighbor shell; select two distinct sites for substitution, keeping their image displacements
3. Replace those two C atoms with N and remove the central C site; preserve the reference identities during index changes
4. Verify both N sites belong to the original vacancy-neighbor shell rather than imposing a collinear N-vacancy-N chain
5. Count (N0-3) C + 2 N, total N0-1; specify the charge state separately

diamond_color_centers.construction_contract: Use the requested parent cell and retain original site identities. For split geometry use complex_defects.split_vacancy_geometry; counts alone do not identify geometry.
